tldr: Meta has released new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, aiming to compete with leading industry models and drive new business opportunities.
US government restrictions on Chinese-made drones are reportedly increasing costs for police departments across the country.
NATO has affirmed its commitment to collective defense, stating it would respond with "anything and everything" if the alliance were attacked.

market.why: Major stock indices, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, closed lower. This occurred amid comments from a Federal Reserve official suggesting that higher interest rates might be necessary to prevent an 'inflationary mindset' from taking hold, and as oil markets struggled to assess the impact of a proposed 'energy ceasefire' on a deepening global oil crisis.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield remained unchanged. The provided articles do not offer a specific explanation for why it stayed flat, despite some Federal Reserve commentary indicating a need for potentially higher rates.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, rose. This increase corresponds with the decline in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, reflecting heightened investor uncertainty driven by concerns over inflation, potential interest rate hikes, and an unresolved global oil crisis.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 43% of the way up its 1-month band. Big session: down 8.1% in a day.
Mid-range - 72% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased by 0.12% in the latest weekly survey. This rise tracks the direction of 10-year Treasury yields over recent days and reflects broader expectations of tighter monetary policy, as a Federal Reserve official suggested higher rates might be needed to combat inflation.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Meta has introduced new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which the company claims are competitive with the industry's best and are expected to drive new business opportunities through paid subscriptions.
Quantum computing company IonQ announced its acquisition of cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock transaction valued at up to $1.3 billion.
Hundreds of French supermarket fridges were affected by a cyber attack, resulting in millions of euros worth of spoiled fresh and frozen food.

world.summary: NATO has declared that it will do "anything and everything" if any member of the alliance is attacked, following warnings about potential Russian actions.

The UK government has attributed recent incidents at RAF airbases to Iran, with the Prime Minister stating they were "likely coordinated" by the country and announcing sanctions against two Iranian nationals.
Ethiopian forces have reportedly entered the strategic Tigray town of Adwa without resistance, according to witness accounts.
An Israeli strike on a tent in Khan Younis, Gaza, resulted in the deaths of three individuals.

us.summary: US government restrictions on Chinese-made drones are causing financial strain for police departments, which rely on these high-quality, low-cost devices.
The Justice Department has initiated an investigation into several TV networks, citing potential anti-trust violations.
Tropical Storm Rachel was downgraded, but its remnants caused flooding that stranded approximately 70 ultramarathon runners on a race route in Utah, who were subsequently evacuated.

science.summary: An international group of researchers is advocating for rigorous scientific study into the potential health benefits of sauna and other heat therapies to establish their legitimacy.
Lawsuits currently allege that GLP-1 medications can lead to serious adverse effects like blindness or pancreatitis, though there is currently scant data on the frequency of these occurrences.
